title: Excel crashing on pivot table
description: User reports that Excel crashes whenever a pivot table is inserted on large datasets.
resolution: Updated Excel version and optimized pivot table source range.

title: Dashboard not loading in Power BI
description: Power BI dashboard fails to load completely, stuck on spinning icon.
resolution: Cleared Power BI cache and reloaded dataset from source.

title: SQL query timing out
description: Long-running SQL query fails after 30 seconds with timeout error.
resolution: Optimized SQL by adding proper indexes and using LIMIT.

title: Python script error in Jupyter
description: Python script throws ValueError when parsing CSV in Jupyter Notebook.
resolution: Added try-except block and fixed delimiter issue in script.

title: Data mismatch in Tableau report
description: Tableau report shows different numbers than expected after data update.
resolution: Refreshed data extract and republished the Tableau workbook.

title: Excel VLOOKUP not working
description: VLOOKUP formula returning N/A even though the value exists in the lookup table.
resolution: Fixed cell references and used IFERROR around VLOOKUP.

title: Slow performance in Power BI
description: Users experiencing delays when interacting with filters on Power BI.
resolution: Improved model performance by reducing query dependencies.

title: Unable to connect to SQL Server
description: Database server not reachable from BI tool, causing connection errors.
resolution: Reconfigured firewall settings to allow SQL Server connection.

title: Broken chart in dashboard
description: Bar chart not rendering properly after report update.
resolution: Regenerated chart visuals with updated parameters.

title: Python pandas groupby not returning expected result
description: Pandas groupby function giving unexpected aggregation results.
resolution: Changed aggregation logic and verified with raw data.

title: Power BI refresh fails
description: Automatic refresh in Power BI service failing due to credentials issue.
resolution: Re-entered credentials in Power BI service and tested refresh.

title: CSV import error in Excel
description: Importing CSV into Excel skips some rows and misaligns columns.
resolution: Formatted CSV with consistent delimiters and header rows.

title: Missing filters in Tableau
description: Filters in Tableau dashboard missing after recent publish.
resolution: Readded filters and re-published with proper permissions.

title: Dashboard permissions issue
description: User not able to access shared dashboard due to permission settings.
resolution: Updated permissions in Tableau Server and notified user.

title: Large Excel file won't open
description: Excel file above 100MB fails to open; crashes Excel.
resolution: Split file into smaller chunks and saved in binary format.

title: Python error: Index out of range
description: List index out of range error when iterating over dataframe rows.
resolution: Added boundary checks to avoid index out of range error.

title: Invalid date format in report
description: Report displays MM/DD/YYYY while client expects DD-MM-YYYY format.
resolution: Updated report templates with user-specific date format.

title: Scheduled refresh not working
description: Dataflow refresh task not triggered as per schedule.
resolution: Manually triggered dataflow and fixed scheduling config.

title: Duplicate rows in SQL output
description: Same row appearing multiple times after SQL execution.
resolution: De-duplicated result using DISTINCT in SQL.

title: Wrong aggregation in dashboard
description: Dashboard totals not summing correctly; appears to be wrong aggregation.
resolution: Fixed aggregation logic in report builder.

title: Can't open Tableau workbook
description: Workbook throws error on open, saying workbook was created in newer version.
resolution: Opened file in latest version and saved in compatible format.

title: Excel formula returns #VALUE!
description: Formula returns error after updating linked sheet.
resolution: Fixed reference errors and locked ranges properly.

title: Error connecting to BigQuery
description: Connection error when accessing BigQuery from data pipeline.
resolution: Verified API key and project permissions for BigQuery.

title: Power BI export to PDF fails
description: Export to PDF in Power BI crashes browser.
resolution: Reduced visual complexity and exported as PNG instead.

title: No data in Jupyter notebook
description: Notebook loads but cells don't execute any code.
resolution: Restarted kernel and ensured proper package imports.

title: Chart titles not updating
description: Titles on charts remain static even after changing parameters.
resolution: Set dynamic chart titles using parameter bindings.

title: Incorrect values after data merge
description: Merged dataset shows misaligned or overwritten data.
resolution: Verified merge logic and fixed overlapping keys.

title: Slow dashboard load in browser
description: Users report slow load time in browser version of dashboard.
resolution: Optimized dashboard for browser rendering.

title: Python plot not displaying
description: Matplotlib plot not rendering inside notebook.
resolution: Installed missing plotting backend and re-ran cell.

title: Excel file corrupted after update
description: File corrupted after system update; won't open properly.
resolution: Recovered from backup and avoided incompatible features.

title: Null values not handled
description: Null values cause errors in downstream calculations.
resolution: Filled nulls with defaults before aggregation.

title: Incorrect fiscal year mapping
description: Sales data assigned to wrong fiscal quarter in report.
resolution: Corrected fiscal mapping table with updated definitions.

title: Data types not matching in merge
description: Merging two dataframes fails due to object vs integer type mismatch.
resolution: Converted types before merge to ensure compatibility.

title: Power BI slicer not filtering
description: Slicer on region not affecting other visuals.
resolution: Fixed slicer relationships in data model.

title: Excel freezes when filtering
description: App becomes unresponsive when user filters large data range.
resolution: Filtered data with helper columns to prevent crash.

title: Jupyter kernel dies on large dataset
description: Kernel restarts automatically on loading dataset >1M rows.
resolution: Used Dask for handling large dataset in notebook.

title: Old data showing in Power BI
description: Outdated values appear even after report refresh.
resolution: Cleared cache and reconnected data source.

title: Formula breaks after copy
description: Formula changes when copying between sheets.
resolution: Used absolute references in formula to avoid shifting.

title: SQL JOIN returns empty
description: INNER JOIN returns no rows though data exists in both tables.
resolution: Checked join keys and fixed inconsistent casing.

title: Unable to publish Tableau dashboard
description: Publish to Tableau Server fails without visible error.
resolution: Checked publishing logs and re-published with clean cache.
